subject: AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE CANADIAN AUTHORITIES PROHIBITING
text:
U1403/26 NOTAMR U0936/26 Q) UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999 A) UUUU  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2610132100  C) 2701111800 EST  E) AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE CANADIAN AUTHORITIES PROHIBITING 
ALL AIRCRAFT, REGARDLESS OF THE STATE OF REGISTRY, DIRECTLY OR 
INDIRECTLY OWNED, CHARTERED, LEASED, OPERATED OR OTHERWISE 
CONTROLLED BY PERSON CONNECTED WITH EITHER THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION 
OR OF BELARUS OR BY CORPORATION OR ENTITY THAT IS INCORPORATED OR 
FORMED UNDER THE LAWS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR BELARUS, AND 
ALL OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY 
RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND/OR BELARUSIAN AUTHORITIES TO ENTER, EXIT OR 
OVERFLY CANADA'S TERRITORIAL AIRSPACE INCLUDING FLT WITHIN 12NM 
OF CANADA'S COASTS WITH EXCEPTIONS FOR ACFT EXPERIENCING INFLIGHT 
EMERGENCY, AND REVOKING ALL AUTHORIZATIONS OBTAINED PRIOR TO 
27.02.2022 FOR ACFT AND OPERATORS SUBJECT TO CANADIAN NOTAM 
G3676/26. 
RUSSIAN AVIATION AUTHORITIES HEREBY DECLARE THAT ALL ACFT, 
REGARDLESS OF STATE OF REGISTRY, DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY OWNED, 
CHARTERED, LEASED, OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY PERSON 
CONNECTED WITH CANADA OR BY CORPORATION OR ENTITY THAT IS 
INCORPORATED OR FORMED UNDER THE LAWS OF CANADA, AND ALL 
OPERATORS HOLDING AOC ISSUED BY CANADIAN AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY THE AIRSPACE OF END PART 1 OF 2
U1403/26 NOTAMR U0936/26 Q) UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999 A) UUUU  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2610132100  C) 2701111800 EST  E) THE 
RUSSIAN FEDERATION, EXCEPT FOR AIRCRAFT IN EMERGENCY, HUMANITARIAN 
OR MEDICAL FLIGHTS AS WELL AS CASES WHEN SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR 
OPERATIONS IS GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR THE 
MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AS 
APPROPRIATE. END PART 2 OF 2
